Question: Assalamalykum My maid has seen a dream in which she saw a dog chasing her,they ran until they came to a desert like place. when she tried to beat him with a rod he started firing on her with a gun After that she woke up from her dream but she was very afraid.Plz tell the meaning of this dream. FiAmamallah Answer ID: 3161 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 207/197=B) She is going to face any difficulty, but she will be safe. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
